latestVersion.changelog:
AI Animation Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly create animated 1080p MP4 videos from your images or text using AI—no motion design skills needed.
- Seamless upload (PNG, JPG, GIF, MP4, up to 200MB) and simple natural language commands for animation and export.
- Automatic cloud backend setup with token management; no manual configuration required.
- Supports exporting, timeline editing, track management (video, audio, text), and credit balance checks via chat commands.
- Real-time status updates and error handling for smooth, uninterrupted creative workflows.
- Ideal for marketers, social media creators, and small business owners needing professional videos—fast.
